user_query: I'm a wine enthusiast and I'm looking to update my wine collection. Can you recommend some premium wines based on my profile? Also, I need to check if any of the recommended wines are available in my cart on Direct Wines. Additionally, I would like to explore some breweries in New York that are known for their dog-friendly facilities. Please provide me with a list of such breweries.

TaskList.description: Gather the user's profile information to provide tailored wine recommendations.
Recommend premium wines based on the user's profile.
Check the user's cart on Direct Wines to see if the recommended wines are available.
Search for breweries in New York known for their dog-friendly facilities.
